observation.command: echo "=== check for any workspace/config extracts ==="; ls -la ~/.deegree 2>/dev/null; ls -la ~/xplanbox 2>/dev/null; ls -la /opt/deegree /opt/xplanbox 2>/dev/null; echo "none found if empty"; echo "=== check if config.apikey anywhere ==="; find / -name "config.apikey" 2>/dev/null; echo "=== check DB port 5432 / rabbit 5672 ==="; timeout 3 bash -c 'cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5432' 2>&1 && echo "5432 open" || echo "5432 closed"; timeout 3 bash -c 'cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5672' 2>&1 && echo "5672 open" || echo "5672 closed"
